job.question: Which retirement system's general investment consultant RFP requires respondents to currently provide non-discretionary general investment advice to at least 5 public pension plans larger than $5 billion and at least 2 public plans over $20 billion?
job.acceptance: TMRS or the full system name is sufficient; repeating thresholds is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission RFP, not a TMRS RFP. Its stated minimum client qualification is different, and it does not state the specified five-plan and two-plan thresholds.
quotes: The South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission (“RSIC”, or “Client”) is requesting competitive proposals
The firm selected must have at least one (1) defined benefit general consulting client with a minimum of $10 billion in assets.
